executed_negative_evidence.observation: WP717 CI compiled successfully and then failed because unrelated valid lifecycle/typed memory could enter the completed heard-result receipt.

basis: Current G3 claimed_scope requires every supplied MemoryLifecycleState payload_ref AND payload_sha256 to equal the exact completed heard-result payload. VSR07A/B prove the broad unrelated-payload case, but a weak repair could still compare only one half of the identity or require merely one matching item in a mixed event.

falsifiers.setup: Build an exact completed heard result H. Create a valid MemoryLifecycleState whose payload_ref equals H.payload_ref but whose payload_sha256 is a different valid lowercase 64-hex digest. Create its matching TypedMemoryRecord and reference its memory_id from memory_event.
falsifiers.failure_signature: Consumer compares payload_ref only and admits a lifecycle state whose content digest is not H.payload_sha256.
falsifiers.repair_guard: Require the lifecycle payload relation as the ordered pair (payload_ref, payload_sha256), not either field independently.

falsifiers.setup: Build exact heard result H. Create a valid MemoryLifecycleState whose payload_sha256 equals H.payload_sha256 but whose payload_ref is a different valid non-empty reference. Create matching TypedMemoryRecord and bind memory_event to that memory_id.
falsifiers.failure_signature: Consumer compares digest only and silently accepts a different semantic reference namespace/subject.
falsifiers.repair_guard: Require exact payload_ref and exact payload_sha256 together.

falsifiers.setup: Create memory_event with two memory_refs in canonical order. First lifecycle/typed pair binds H.payload_ref and H.payload_sha256 exactly. Second pair is internally valid but binds an unrelated payload. Supply both pairs to bind_completed_reentry.
falsifiers.failure_signature: Repair checks that at least one memory pair matches H and then emits memory_evidence containing an unrelated lifecycle state under the same completed heard-result receipt.
falsifiers.repair_guard: Under current G3 claimed_scope, every supplied MemoryLifecycleState admitted into this receipt must bind the exact heard-result payload pair; do not convert a set-existence check into relation proof.

acceptance_guidance: The G3 mutation owner should add split-identity and mixed-set regressions while implementing the already-authorized VSR07 lifecycle payload fence. This packet does not authorize source mutation and does not reopen the rescaled reference-only GWT decision.
next_exact_action: G3 mutation owner refreshes main, applies the smallest existing-consumer VSR07 fence requiring every supplied lifecycle payload_ref+payload_sha256 pair to equal the exact heard result, runs the complete WP717 repository CI including VSR07A-E, then binds a new exact-source VPS subject only after green repository evidence.
